description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for verifying 'git push' push options functionality, including push options handling, configuration, submodules, and interactions over HTTP. It defines functions to set up repositories, perform tests, and validate the behavior of push options in a Git environment.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Sets up a pair of repositories (upstream and workbench), configuring hooks to handle push options on the upstream repository, and adds a remote in the workbench pointing to upstream.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares the specified git references (branches or commits) between upstream and workbench repositories to verify consistency.

methods.name: mk_http_pair
methods.description: Sets up repositories over HTTP with push options configuration, makes a clone, and prepares for HTTP-specific push option tests.
